day.name: This day in history: Jhalkari Bai's birth anniversary
day.about: Jhalkari Bai, born on 22 November 1830 near Jhansi, was a brave soldier in the women's army of Rani Lakshmibai. During the 1857 revolt, she dressed like the Rani and led the British forces away so that the Rani could escape. She is remembered as a symbol of courage, and the Government of India issued a postage stamp in her honour in 2001.

headlines.title: IIT Kharagpur, India's first IIT, celebrates its Platinum Jubilee with a visit by PM Narendra Modi.
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited IIT Kharagpur in West Bengal on 21 November 2026 for the institute's Platinum Jubilee, which marks 75 years. He unveiled a special commemorative coin for the occasion. The programme also included an interaction with 75 students and the launch of a postgraduate medical course at the institute. On the same day, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai, a former IIT Kharagpur student, announced USD 5 million from Google for AI research and training at the institute. Later that day, the PM was scheduled to visit Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
headlines.gk: IIT Kharagpur was set up in 1951 as India's first IIT. A platinum jubilee marks 75 years; a golden jubilee marks 50 and a diamond jubilee 60.

headlines.title: Centre and States aim to give SVAMITVA property cards to every eligible village by 31 March 2027.
headlines.summary: A national review meeting on the SVAMITVA scheme was held in New Delhi on 20 November 2026. It was addressed by Union Panchayati Raj Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh and Minister of State Prof. S. P. Singh Baghel, with ministers from nine States attending. Drone surveys have been completed in 3.28 lakh villages, and 3.47 crore property cards have been made so far. The Centre and States agreed to complete the work everywhere by 31 March 2027. The cards give villagers legal proof that they own their houses and land.
headlines.gk: SVAMITVA was launched by PM Modi on 24 April 2020 (National Panchayati Raj Day). It maps village homes using drones and GIS, and banks now accept the property cards as security for loans.

headlines.title: A Russian strike on President Zelenskyy's hometown kills two people and injures 60.
headlines.summary: A Russian attack hit Kryvyi Rih, the hometown of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, on the night of 20 November 2026. A seven-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman were killed, and 60 people were injured, including six children. About 25 apartment buildings, a hospital, schools and businesses were damaged, said city official Oleksandr Vilkul. On the same day, two Russian missiles and a suspected drone landed in south-eastern Poland. Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk called it a deliberate provocation, and NATO chief Mark Rutte condemned it.
headlines.gk: Ukraine's capital is Kyiv. NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) was founded in 1949 and has its headquarters in Brussels, Belgium; Poland is a member.

headlines.title: Africa's own credit rating agency gets ready to issue its first ratings of African governments.
headlines.summary: The African Union launched the Africa Credit Rating Agency (AfCRA) on 7 October, with its base in Port Louis, Mauritius. A credit rating shows how safe it is to lend money to a government or company. AfCRA will use local data and African experts, and expects to give its first government ratings by the end of March. Its interim chief executive, Sifiso Falala, says it is in talks with 15 African governments. A 2023 UNDP study estimated that unfair ratings cost African countries about $74.5 billion in extra interest and lost loans.
headlines.gk: The African Union was formed in 2002, replacing the Organisation of African Unity (founded 1963). Its headquarters is in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

headlines.title: COP31 climate talks run into overtime over fossil fuels before a late-night consensus is announced.
headlines.summary: The COP31 UN climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, was due to end on Friday, 20 November, but went into overtime. Nearly 200 countries were divided over whether the final text should mention moving away from coal, oil and gas. An earlier draft removed all mention of fossil fuels and dropped a $120 billion target for helping poorer countries adapt, angering many developing nations. Late on Saturday, COP31 President Murat Kurum, Türkiye's environment minister, announced consensus on a revised text at a late-night meeting. A session to formally approve it was set for Sunday morning.
headlines.gk: COP stands for 'Conference of the Parties' to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), adopted at the 1992 Rio Earth Summit. The 2015 Paris Agreement aims to keep warming well below 2°C, preferably 1.5°C.
headlines.source: GMA News via Headtopics; Arab News (AFP)

headlines.title: Lakshya Sen and Satwik-Chirag lose in the Hong Kong Open semi-finals, ending India's campaign.
headlines.summary: India's Lakshya Sen, ranked world No. 11, lost his men's singles semi-final at the Hong Kong Open to world No. 3 Anders Antonsen of Denmark, 13-21, 13-21, on 21 November 2026. The defeat ended Sen's 13-match winning streak. In the quarter-final, he had beaten Singapore's former world champion Loh Kean Yew. In men's doubles, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty lost their semi-final to Malaysia's Tee Kai Wun and Man Wei Chong, 18-21, 19-21. These results ended India's campaign at the tournament.
headlines.gk: The Hong Kong Open is part of the BWF World Tour. The Badminton World Federation (BWF) has its headquarters in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

headlines.title: Commercial coal mine auctions draw 85 bids for 18 blocks, including 20 first-time bidders.
headlines.summary: The Ministry of Coal's Nominated Authority opened bids on 20 November 2026 for the 16th round of commercial coal mine auctions and the second attempt of the 15th round. In all, 26 coal blocks in eight States were offered. The ministry received 85 bids for 18 blocks: 83 bids for 17 blocks in the 16th round and 2 bids for 1 block in the 15th-round retry. Twenty bidders were taking part for the first time. Output from captive and commercial mines rose 10.22% to 210.46 million tonnes in 2025-26.
headlines.gk: Commercial coal mining was opened to private players in 2020. Since then 145 mines have been auctioned over 15 rounds, expected to yield about Rs 47,500 crore a year and about 4.9 lakh jobs.
headlines.exam: Remember: 16th round (+15th round retry); 26 blocks in 8 States; 85 bids for 18 blocks; 20 first-time bidders; captive/commercial output +10.22% to 210.46 MT in FY26.

headlines.title: Basmati rice exports rise about 25% to US$1.60 billion in April-September 2026-27.
headlines.summary: A government backgrounder released on 20 November 2026 showed strong growth in India's agricultural exports in the first half of 2026-27. Basmati rice exports rose about 25.4%, from US$1.28 billion to US$1.60 billion, with Iran, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Yemen, Oman and the US among the main buyers. Exports of processed frozen potatoes grew 20.8%, mainly to Indonesia, Japan and East and South-East Asia. Exports of yellow dent corn rose about twelve-fold, going to Vietnam, Bangladesh and the Philippines.
headlines.gk: APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority), set up in 1986 under the Commerce Ministry, promotes agri exports. Basmati rice has a GI tag.
headlines.exam: Remember: H1 FY27 – Basmati exports +25.4% (US$1.28 bn → US$1.60 bn); frozen potatoes +20.8%; yellow dent corn ~12-fold.
headlines.source: CrackTarget (21 Nov current affairs, PIB backgrounder)

headlines.title: PMAY-Urban 2.0 committee sanctions 1.75 lakh more houses, over 1 lakh of them in Uttar Pradesh.
headlines.summary: The 11th meeting of the Central Sanctioning and Monitoring Committee (CSMC) of PMAY-Urban 2.0 was held on 19 November 2026, chaired by Satendra Singh, Secretary, Department of Urban Development, Housing and Urban Affairs Ministry. It sanctioned 1.75 lakh houses in 11 States and UTs under the Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC) and Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) verticals. Uttar Pradesh got the most, 1,01,493 houses. In-principle approval was given for 1,27,349 houses in Andhra Pradesh and 22,484 in Maharashtra. Total sanctions under PMAY-U 2.0 have now crossed 24.15 lakh.
headlines.gk: PMAY-Urban 2.0 is the second phase of the 'Housing for All' mission for cities, run by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
headlines.exam: Remember: 11th CSMC, PMAY-U 2.0; 1.75 lakh houses in 11 States/UTs; UP 1,01,493; total sanctions >24.15 lakh; BLC and AHP verticals.

headlines.title: MoSPI to hold a Data Users Conference in Mumbai on 23 November on the new GDP, CPI and IIP series.
headlines.summary: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) has announced a Data Users Conference on the new GDP, CPI and IIP series, to be held in Mumbai on 23 November 2026. The new National Accounts series, with base year 2022-23, was released on 27 February 2026 and updated in August 2026. The new CPI series, with base year 2024, was released on 12 February 2026 and is based on the Household Consumption Expenditure Survey 2023-24. Its basket has grown to 358 items, including 50 services.
headlines.gk: CPI = Consumer Price Index (retail inflation); IIP = Index of Industrial Production. The RBI uses CPI inflation as its main target (4% ± 2%).
headlines.exam: Remember: MoSPI Data Users Conference, Mumbai, 23 Nov 2026; GDP base year 2022-23; CPI base year 2024 (358 items, 50 services; HCES 2023-24).

headlines.title: National Gopal Ratna Award 2026 winners announced; awards to be given on National Milk Day in Patna.
headlines.summary: The Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying announced the winners of the National Gopal Ratna Award 2026 on 20 November 2026. The awards will be presented on National Milk Day, 26 November 2026, in Patna, Bihar. There are three categories: best dairy farmer rearing indigenous cattle or buffalo breeds, best dairy cooperative society/milk producer company/dairy FPO, and best Artificial Insemination Technician. A special award is given for the North Eastern Region and Himalayan States. In the first two categories, the prizes are Rs 5 lakh, Rs 3 lakh and Rs 2 lakh; 1,583 applications were received.
headlines.gk: The award comes under the Rashtriya Gokul Mission (launched December 2014). National Milk Day (26 November) marks the birth anniversary of Dr Verghese Kurien, the 'Father of the White Revolution'.
headlines.exam: Remember: Gopal Ratna 2026 – Rashtriya Gokul Mission; presented 26 Nov in Patna; 3 categories + NER/Himalayan special award; Rs 5/3/2 lakh; 1,583 applications.

headlines.title: INSA President Prof. Shekhar C. Mande appointed to the UN's 10-member group on science and technology for the SDGs.
headlines.summary: Prof. Shekhar C. Mande, President of the Indian National Science Academy (INSA), has been appointed by the UN Secretary-General to the Group of Ten High-level Representatives of Civil Society, Private Sector and Scientific Community. The group promotes science, technology and innovation (STI) for the Sustainable Development Goals. His term is 2026-2028, the Ministry of Science and Technology said on 20 November 2026. The group is co-chaired by experts from Ghana and Italy, with other members from countries including Sweden, Brazil, Japan and China.
headlines.gk: The 10-Member Group is part of the UN Technology Facilitation Mechanism. The 17 SDGs were adopted by the UN in 2015 for the 2030 Agenda. INSA was founded in 1935 and is based in New Delhi.
headlines.exam: Remember: Prof. Shekhar C. Mande (INSA President) – UN 10-Member Group on STI for SDGs, 2026-28; co-chairs from Ghana and Italy; part of UN Technology Facilitation Mechanism.

ai.title: Jadavpur University PhD scholar Abhiroop Chatterjee wins a Google PhD Fellowship 2026 in machine learning.
ai.summary: Abhiroop Chatterjee, a PhD student in Computer Science and Engineering at Jadavpur University, has won a Google PhD Fellowship for 2026. He is the first person from his university to get it. His research aims to make AI models more efficient and reliable, which could help in areas like healthcare and mapping. He is one of only three researchers from India in the Machine Learning category, and one of 43 worldwide in that category. In total, 148 young researchers from 38 countries were chosen.
ai.gk: Google was founded in 1998 by Larry Page and Sergey Brin; its parent company Alphabet is led by Sundar Pichai. Machine learning is a branch of AI in which computers learn patterns from data.

quiz.q: Abhiroop Chatterjee of Jadavpur University won which company's PhD Fellowship 2026?
quiz.explain: He won the Google PhD Fellowship 2026 in the Machine Learning category.

ai.title: IIT Mandi researchers build an AI-based model that predicts how wolf and moose numbers will change.
ai.summary: Researchers at IIT Mandi in Himachal Pradesh have made a computer model that uses AI to forecast changes in wildlife numbers. Professor Nitu Kumari and her PhD student Anurag Singh studied grey wolves and moose on Isle Royale, an island in Lake Superior in the USA, where the animals have been counted every year since 1959. The model learns from old records and can predict numbers up to five years ahead. For 2020-2024, it correctly showed wolves rising and moose falling, broadly matching what really happened.
ai.gk: Wolves are predators and moose are their prey. Lake Superior is the largest of North America's five Great Lakes.

quiz.q: Which two animals did the IIT Mandi AI model study?
quiz.explain: The model studied grey wolves and moose on Isle Royale in Lake Superior, USA.

ai.title: Google announces USD 5 million for IIT Kharagpur to boost AI research, teacher training and edtech.
ai.summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai announced on 21 November 2026 that Google will give USD 5 million (about Rs 46 crore) to IIT Kharagpur. The money will support AI research in Indic languages, materials science, agriculture and educational technology. It will also fund AI training and curriculum development for students, faculty and teachers, and strengthen AI infrastructure on campus. Pichai, an IIT Kharagpur alumnus, made the announcement on the day PM Narendra Modi visited the institute for its Platinum Jubilee.
ai.gk: IIT Kharagpur (West Bengal), set up in 1951, was India's first IIT and is an Institute of National Importance.
ai.exam: Remember: Google → USD 5 million (~Rs 46 crore) to IIT Kharagpur; announced by Sundar Pichai (IIT KGP alumnus); focus: Indic languages, materials science, agriculture, edtech, teacher training.

quiz.q: How much funding did Google announce for AI research and training at IIT Kharagpur?
quiz.explain: Sundar Pichai announced USD 5 million (about Rs 46 crore) for IIT Kharagpur.

ai.title: Angelo State University starts a two-year programme to teach AI skills and set rules for responsible AI use.
ai.summary: Angelo State University in Texas, USA, has chosen education consultancy Kovexa Solutions for a two-year programme to build its Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence. The plan links AI skills training with clear rules on how the university governs AI use. Students, faculty and community members will create practical AI projects to solve local problems. The framework rests on five pillars: Govern, Learn, Scale, Build and Connect. A two-year study will measure the programme's impact and check that AI is used responsibly.
ai.gk: A 'Centre of Excellence' is a dedicated unit leading research and training in one field. India has set up a Centre of Excellence in AI for Education at IIT Madras.
ai.exam: Remember: Angelo State University (Texas) + Kovexa Solutions; two-year AI Centre of Excellence; five pillars – Govern, Learn, Scale, Build, Connect.

quiz.q: How many pillars does the framework for Angelo State's AI programme have?
quiz.explain: Govern, Learn, Scale, Build and Connect.
